Hi Taylor / Elena,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Per our conversation, attaching the initial intake so we can align on templates, signatory path, and the first-pass redline timeline. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm preferred contract template (Redwood standard MSA vs counterparty redline).
- Provide billing contact, PO process, and initial seat count for Order Form (we can accept a range).
- Designate who can sign on Solara's side (name + title + email) — we usually ask for a CSV signer matrix.
- Any specific hosting/residency restrictions (data residency / EU processing) or security evidence items beyond SOC 2?

If you can send the Order Form stub and signer matrix, we’ll kick legal review and aim for a 2-business-day first-pass on redlines. I’ve CC’d Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (contracts) to coordinate.

Thanks,

Thanks Taylor — copying my initial checklist in case helpful for procurement and to scope the redline drive: 

1) Template selection: we’ll start from Redwood standard MSA (attached in-drive) and apply commercial redlines for exhibits only. If Solara insists on counterparty template, expect a longer review cycle (we’ll flag core deviations).

2) Priority clauses for our first-pass redline: indemnity language (cap + carveouts), data processing & residency, subprocessor notice, security evidence appendix, termination for convenience, and IP ownership on outputs.

3) Evidence/Qs: if you have recent SOC 2 report or questionnaire answers, please share — it speeds review of the security exhibit.

4) Signing authority: confirm that Elena is Legal Ops Director (can sign up to $500k) — if procurement needs CFO, flag that now so we can coordinate timeline.

Plan: Ben/Marissa will route Order Form to operations; I’ll produce redline comments and a short summary doc (MSA_Redline_Instructions.pdf) that highlights non-negotiables vs commercial asks. Target: first-pass redline back to you by 2026-10-04 EOD PST (2 business days).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
